Name: Nastradamus
Type: After dropping I Am… in April 1999, Nas came right back with Nastradamus seven months later. Despite heavy criticism of the album’s production, the album still went on to achieve platinum status with support from the singles “Nastradamus” and the Timbaland-produced “You Owe Me” featuring Ginuwine. The title track was significant as the line “You wanna ball ‘til you fall, I can help you with that” was seen as a shot at Roc-a-Fella Records artist Memphis Bleek by referencing the chorus of his single “What You Think of That.” This helped spark the battle between Nas and JAY-Z in the following years.

Type: Nas, or as it's most commonly known by, Nigger, is Nas' 9th solo studio album and released on July 7th, 2008. This album is Nas' most controversial in his entire catalogue, mostly down to its original title. Whilst various celebrities and thousands of fans defended the album's title, Nas was not allowed to release it under that name and was forced to change it to a self-titled/untitled album. The album is very political, focusing on both historic and modern day racism, as well as modern American politics, throwing shots at various politicians and TV news networks in tracks such as "Sly Fox".
